sentences.l2: 駅前の商店街は、大きなスーパーができてから客が減っていた。
sentences.l1: The shopping street in front of the station had been losing customers since the big supermarket opened.

sentences.l2: そこで、地元の高校生たちが商店街の魅力を発信する活動を始めた。
sentences.l1: So, local high school students started an activity to promote the charm of the shopping street.

sentences.l2: それぞれの店の人に話を聞き、店の歴史やおすすめの商品を写真と一緒にインターネットで紹介したのだ。
sentences.l1: They listened to the people at each shop and introduced the shops' histories and recommended products on the internet together with photos.

sentences.l2: すると、若い人や町の外から来る客が少しずつ増えた。
sentences.l1: Then, young people and customers coming from outside the town gradually increased.

sentences.l2: 店の人たちは「自分たちでは気づかなかった良さを教えてもらった」と喜んでいる。
sentences.l1: The shop owners are delighted, saying, "They showed us a good point that we had not noticed ourselves."
